name: Ugly Purple
lede: Ugly Purple is a strong, reddish [[purple]] from the xkcd 2010 crowd-name survey, one of several judgmental names ordinary respondents volunteered rather than a modifier of another word.

sections.title: A judgment, not a description
sections.body:
The 2010 xkcd survey let respondents type any name for a swatch, and a number of them reached for blunt opinions like this one instead of a hue word; who first used it beyond the survey is undocumented [1]. The ISCC-NBS block for the region reads "strong reddish purple" [1].

Our library also records Orchid Magenta as a near-duplicate of this swatch, within rounding of the same color [1]. Its closest standing colors are [[byzantine]], 4.5 units away by CIEDE2000 and more vivid, [[purple-plum]] at 5.1, purpler and more vivid, and [[purple-plum]] at 5.6, purpler [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has this color covering at least 1% of its canvas, within CIEDE2000 4 of it, as photographed [3]. That describes what our particular archive happened to collect, not painting as a whole, and it is not a judgment of the color itself [3].
